C0749.title: Tangshan Bank APP Flagged for Mandatory, Frequent, and Excessive Permission Requests
C0749.summary: The Hebei Provincial Communications Administration flagged Tangshan Bank's "Tanghang Enterprise Banking" APP for mandatory, frequent, and excessive permission requests, requiring rectification. The app has since completed the required fixes and updated its privacy policy pop-up prompts.

references.title: Hebei Communications Administration Notice on Apps Infringing User Rights
